source.rule: Manual p454 defines QTYNC as the number of items or subsystems of MID belonging to a noncritical set. The dictionary requires positive integer QTYNC, default 1. This pair physically installs two POS-B copies and compares one versus two designated noncritical members.

configuration.shared: From accepted G09.var03 v1.0.1 omitted-nc-b1, increase physical MaterielStructure POS-B QTYPM1 to2 in both arms. Retain POS-B omission from selected BASIC RBDSeries, NCID G09-NC-B, both B copies' inherited LRU, physical failure modes/rates, direct CM, PAR active parallel, h8/h20/h32 missions, seed1/rep1/horizon36.
configuration.pair: Only ProblemDescription and RBDNonCriticalSetItems.POS-B.QTYNC differ: qty1 retains 1 and qty2 sets 2. Both arms use USERT1.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both arms convert with zero errors and reviewed diagnostics; native populated-table import/export roundtrips exactly with two installed POS-B copies.

At least one POS-B physical failure occurs under BASIC and the matched seeded event sequence allows an observed severity or mission-outcome distinction between QTYNC1 and QTYNC2. Exact event times, copy order and later events are empirical, not assumed from the one-copy parent.
Reports reconcile mission outcomes, failure/repair counts, 72 System/Stock bins, no stock movement and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: Two immutable guarded serial session-0 SSH runs with host mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source/control fingerprints and 13 raw SHA-256 seals each.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event logs/reports and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay establishes only the observed two-copy QTYNC contrast; native log may report copy IDs and severity but does not print NCID/QTYNC selection.
diagnostic_gate: If the two arms have no matched B failure or no attributable severity/mission distinction, keep both runs as diagnostic and revise under a new version/run ID; do not change this frozen hypothesis.
limits: Two physically installed POS-B copies, one selected BASIC system mode, NCID G09-NC-B, QTYNC1 versus2 and USERT1, one aircraft/seed/replication. Other quantities, placements, modes, rates and seeds remain open.

QTYPM changes from the accepted one-copy parent in both arms. The within-pair delta isolates QTYNC; copy assignment rules, stochastic laws, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
